source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Simple CalDAV responses use the HTTP channel contentCharset with a UTF-8 fallback. The XML handler instead stores raw byte chunks, concatenates them and then decodes using the recorded channel charset. Each new chunk invalidates the decoded cache; reset clears chunks, channel and cache. This removes the old per-chunk UTF-8 assumption. The source does not establish support for every encoding label, malformed input or split boundary without dedicated tests.
title: CalDAV XML responses preserve raw chunks until charset decoding
